sloka: मोक्षितौ च महाघोरादस्मात् सायकबन्धनात् ।अप्रमादश्च कर्तव्यो युवाभ्यां नित्यमेव हि ।। ६.५०.५२ ।।।।
transliteration: mokṣitau ca mahāghorādasmāt sāyakabandhanāt ।apramādaśca kartavyo yuvābhyāṁ nityameva hi ।। 6.50.52 ।।।।

translations.english: "Considering it as my duty to relieve you both from the frightful bondage of snakes I reached. Do not be inattentive and guileless."
